title: Detroit Lions and New Orleans Saints face off in Week 1
seoTitle: Detroit Lions vs. New Orleans Saints – Week 1 kickoff
subtitle: The matchup opens the 2026 NFL season with roster updates and fresh storylines.
excerpt: The Detroit Lions and New Orleans Saints meet on Sunday for the opening game of the 2026 NFL season.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: bet365, CBS Sports, Powell River Peak
contentHtml:
The opening of the 2026 NFL season features a showdown between the Detroit Lions and the New Orleans Saints, igniting the early‑season buzz. The teams will take the field in Detroit for the first game of the year, stirring market projections and fan anticipation.

How the teams arrive for the debut

The Detroit Lions host the game at Ford Field, looking to move past last season’s 9‑8 record. The club retained head coach Dan Campbell and leaned on running back Jahmyr Gibbs, who has taken on an even larger role in the offense after David Montgomery’s departure to the Houston Texans. On the other side, the New Orleans Saints arrive with second‑year head coach Kellen Moore and quarterback Tyler Shough ready for his first full season as starter, after finishing last year with wins in four of his final five games.

Offensive upgrades and additions

The Saints bolstered their offense with the addition of running back Travis Etienne Jr., joining Alvin Kamara and receiver Chris Olave. The squad also features rookie Jordyn Tyson among its new offensive weapons. Meanwhile, the Lions are banking on continuity at quarterback with Jared Goff, who threw dozens of touchdown passes last season, and rely on targets such as Amon‑Ra St. Brown and Jameson Williams to keep one of the league’s most productive attacks humming.

Defensive matchups on the field

The Saints’ defense will be tasked with containing the Goff‑Gibbs attack, paying special attention to secondary coverage of St. Brown and leveraging playmakers like Kool‑Aid McKinstry. Conversely, the Lions’ defense, anchored by Aidan Hutchinson after a standout sack season, aims to pressure the young New Orleans quarterback and limit red‑zone conversions.

Where to watch and broadcast details

The Week 1 game takes place on Sunday, September 13, 2026, at 1 p.m. Eastern Time. FOX will televise the contest with a crew that includes Kenny Albert, Jonathan Vilma and Megan Olivi. Local fans can also stream the broadcast via the official Lions website or mobile app, while radio coverage features Dan Miller and Lomas Brown.
